newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin heart operation to be mid-November- agency.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin heart operation to be mid-November- agency.

text.p: Doctors will operate on Russian President Boris Yeltsin in mid-November, Interfax news agency quoted the head of the Kremlin medical centre as saying on Wednesday.
"The operation on President Boris Yeltsin's heart will be carried out as planned in the middle of November," Sergei Mironov said. "There are no grounds to say that Boris Yeltsin is inoperable."

Mironov said that "elements of anaemia" -- a shortage of red blood cells -- were one of the main worries for doctors treating the president. The red blood cells play a key role in carrying oxygen around the body.
"Now this problem is gradually being solved and there are no blood supply problems which would make the operation impossible," Mironov said.
The treatment Yeltsin was getting had resulted in "positive changes" in the quality of his blood, the doctor added.
Virtually non-stop rumours about Yeltsin's health have unsettled financial markets in Russia and the West and the Kremlin has frequently been forced to deny them.
